name: Athanasius of Alexandria
contribution: An Egyptian Christian theologian and the 20th Patriarch of Alexandria.
legacy: His heroic efforts against Arianism have won him wide acclaim in both the East and West under the title "Father of Orthodoxy," and his writings continue to be widely read.

checks.lead: Athanasius I of Alexandria (c. 296–298 – 2 May 373), also called Athanasius the Great, Athanasius the Confessor, or, among Coptic Christians, Athanasius the Apostolic, was an Egyptian Christian theologian and the 20th Patriarch of Alexandria. His intermittent episcopacy spanned 45 years (328 – 373).
